beats.summary: Dwight shows Jim a certificate of bravery from the police department.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: Certificate of Bravery, from the Scranton Police Department.

beats.summary: Michael and Jan have a tense negotiation about a raise.

evidence.snippet: Jan: No. But we can offer you 12.

beats.summary: Michael humorously describes his view of negotiation and perks.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Negotiation is an art. Back and forth. Give and take.

beats.summary: Angela and Dwight plan to read tales of bravery together and share a kiss.
